study type: In vitro study with cross-sectional tissue collection
cohort: The study utilized placenta tissues from pregnant women with and without preeclampsia, alongside a human trophoblast cell line (HTR-8/SVneo) for in vitro experiments.
finding: Edaravone protected trophoblast cells against hypoxic injury by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT pathway, suggesting it may serve as a promising therapeutic option for preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Placenta tissues were collected from pregnant women, likely at delivery.
